description: TWIST1 diagnostic yield vs VUS burden across the craniosynostosis gene panel, with Clopper-Pearson CIs
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact, beta

rows=[("TWIST1",363,159,141,42),("TCF12",656,175,288,159),("FGFR1",1480,315,572,437),
      ("FGFR2",1066,185,420,381),("FGFR3",1558,229,634,575),("EFNB1",381,203,105,44),
      ("ERF",355,75,180,86),("MSX2",298,31,143,119),("RUNX2",750,222,309,179),
      ("ALX4",374,43,181,138),("EFNA4",76,14,39,18),("ZIC1",247,33,112,98),
      ("IL11RA",220,103,37,61),("SMAD6",1418,97,860,386),("SPECC1L",569,65,320,161)]
df=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["gene","total","plp","vus","blb"])
df["pct_vus"]=100*df.vus/df.total; df["pct_plp"]=100*df.plp/df.total
def ci(k,n):
    lo=beta.ppf(0.025,k,n-k+1) if k>0 else 0.0
    hi=beta.ppf(0.975,k+1,n-k) if k<n else 1.0
    return 100*lo,100*hi
df[["lo","hi"]]=df.apply(lambda r: pd.Series(ci(int(r.plp),int(r.total))),axis=1)

s=df.sort_values("pct_plp")
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5.6))

ax=axes[0]; y=np.arange(len(s))
cols=["#b2182b" if g=="TWIST1" else "#8aa8c4" for g in s.gene]
ax.barh(y,s.pct_plp,color=cols,edgecolor="k",linewidth=0.4)
ax.errorbar(s.pct_plp,y,xerr=[s.pct_plp-s.lo,s.hi-s.pct_plp],fmt="none",ecolor="k",elinewidth=0.9,capsize=2.5)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([f"{g} (n={n})" for g,n in zip(s.gene,s.total)],fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("percent of ClinVar records classified P/LP (95% CI)")
ax.set_title("Pathogenic yield, craniosynostosis panel genes\nTWIST1 43.8% vs rest of core panel 21.5%, OR 2.84, p = 7.3e-20",fontsize=10)
ax.axvline(21.5,ls="--",c="grey",lw=1)

ax=axes[1]; s2=df.sort_values("pct_vus"); y=np.arange(len(s2))
cols=["#b2182b" if g=="TWIST1" else "#8aa8c4" for g in s2.gene]
ax.barh(y,s2.pct_vus,color=cols,edgecolor="k",linewidth=0.4)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(s2.gene,fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("percent of ClinVar records classified VUS")
ax.set_title("VUS burden: TWIST1 38.8% vs rest of core panel 40.0%\nno difference, Fisher p = 0.70 (hypothesis refuted)",fontsize=10)
ax.axvline(40.0,ls="--",c="grey",lw=1)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print(df.sort_values("pct_plp",ascending=False)[["gene","total","plp","pct_plp","lo","hi","pct_vus"]].round(1).to_string(index=False))
